oil.when: 2016 500X, with either a push-button start or a key
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Switch the ignition on without starting the engine. With push-button start, press START/STOP without touching the brake; with a key, turn it to the run position.
Slowly press the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Switch the ignition off again (press START/STOP once without the brake, or turn the key to off).
Start the engine. If the oil change message appears again, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
oil.note: Pressing the MENU button only hides the message for now; it does not reset the reminder.

steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Switch the ignition to ON without starting the engine.
Slowly press the accelerator pedal all the way down and let it up, three times, all within about 10 seconds.
Switch the ignition back to OFF.
Start the engine. If the oil change message appears again, the reset did not take, so repeat the steps.
